links.outcome: LLM accuracy compared with physicians on the same comorbidity extraction reports
links.effect: GPT-4 outperformed physicians (McNemar p<0.001); sensitivity 96.8% vs 88.8% for physicians; physicians slightly better in precision (97.7% vs 96.8%). GPT-3.5 not significantly different (p=0.79).
links.quote: GPT-4 demonstrated clear superiority in several key metrics (McNemar’s test p < 0.001).

screen.reason: Empirical study evaluating the performance and error modes of GPT-3.5 and GPT-4 compared to physician specialists for structuring oncology comorbidity data from clinical free-text.
